display.name: Discord
display.blurb: Read and post Discord messages, inspect channels, guilds, and members — authenticated with a bot token brokered host-side (the agent never sees it).

cli.doc:
Use `discord` to talk to the Discord REST API (v10) from this session — read and post channel messages, inspect channels, guilds, and members. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the real, capability-scoped bot token (`Authorization: Bot …`) on every request to discord.com; `DISCORD_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login. Channel/guild/user IDs are non-secret snowflake args you pass on the command line.

Subcommands and the power each needs:
- `discord whoami` — show the bot identity (GET /users/@me). Needs `users:read`.
- `discord messages <channel-id> [limit=50]` — list recent messages (GET /channels/<id>/messages). Needs `messages:read`.
- `discord post <channel-id> <text…>` — post a message (POST /channels/<id>/messages). Needs `messages:write`.
- `discord edit <channel-id> <message-id> <text…>` — edit a message (PATCH). Needs `messages:write`.
- `discord delete <channel-id> <message-id>` — delete a message (DELETE). Needs `messages:write`.
- `discord channel <channel-id>` — fetch a channel (GET /channels/<id>). Needs `channels:read`.
- `discord guild <guild-id>` — fetch a guild (GET /guilds/<id>). Needs `guilds:read`.
- `discord members <guild-id> [limit=100]` — list guild members (GET /guilds/<id>/members). Needs `guilds:read`.
- `discord dm <user-id> <text…>` — open a DM channel then post (POST /users/@me/channels + POST /channels/<id>/messages). Needs `dms:write` AND `messages:write`.
- `discord get <path>` / `discord api <METHOD> <path> [json]` — raw passthrough under /api/v10 (e.g. `discord get /users/@me`). The power is whatever the method+path resolves to.

A call to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated. Discord returns JSON on success and `{"message":"…","code":…}` on error.
